title: $\ell^{p}$ improving estimates for multilinear forms motivated by distance graphs
summary: We undertake a systematic study of the mapping properties of forms based on distance graphs in $\mathbb{Z}^{d}$ to see how the structure of a graph, $G$, affects the $\ell^{p}$ improving estimates of the form, $Λ_{G}$, based on $G$. This extends previous work on $\ell^{p}$ improving properties for the spherical averaging operator, which corresponds to a distance graph of a single distance. We obtain $\ell^{p}$ improving estimates for the collection of forms based on all graphs with 2, 3, and 4 vertices, as well as chains and simplexes of any size in $\mathbb{Z}^{d}$.
